Most of my publications can be found at [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=VcrhCsgAAAAJ&hl=en). Below, work in progress is listed first; let me know if you want more information about any of these projects.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(RefManageR)

suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8"))

# Helper: extract a field value (raw string) from a BibEntry
field <- function(entry, f) {
  e <- unclass(entry)[[1]]
  v <- e[[f]]
  if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0 || (length(v) == 1 && is.na(v))) return("")
  if (inherits(v, "person")) return(format(v))
  as.character(v)
}

# --- Google Scholar cross-reference -----------------------------------------
#
# We only want to show a "find on Google Scholar" icon for entries that are
# actually listed on Ingmar's Scholar profile (rather than guessing via a
# generic title search for every single entry). Scholar itself can't be
# queried at render time (it blocks non-browser requests), so instead we keep
# a local snapshot of the profile's publication titles -- data/scholar-titles.txt,
# one title per line, scraped from
# https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=VcrhCsgAAAAJ&hl=en&cstart=0&pagesize=100
# (click "Show more" to load all, then collect `.gsc_a_at` link text).
# Refresh that file occasionally to pick up newly indexed papers.
norm_title <- function(s) {
  s <- tolower(s)
  s <- iconv(s, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  s <- gsub("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ", s)
  s <- gsub("\\s+", " ", s)
  trimws(s)
}

.scholar_titles_path <- "data/scholar-titles.txt"
scholar_titles_norm <- if (file.exists(.scholar_titles_path)) {
  vapply(readLines(.scholar_titles_path, warn = FALSE), norm_title, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
} else character(0)

# Is `title` (already brace-stripped) listed on the Scholar profile? Mirrors
# the matching rules used to build the snapshot: exact match, containment
# (only when the shorter/contained string is itself long & specific, >= 30
# normalized characters -- short generic titles like "Hidden Markov Models"
# are substrings of many unrelated titles and would otherwise false-match),
# or a shared, sufficiently long prefix (handles subtitle truncation).
on_scholar <- function(title) {
  bn <- norm_title(title)
  if (nchar(bn) < 3 || length(scholar_titles_norm) == 0) return(FALSE)
  any(vapply(scholar_titles_norm, function(sn) {
    min_len <- min(nchar(sn), nchar(bn))
    if (sn == bn) return(TRUE)
    if (min_len >= 30 && (grepl(sn, bn, fixed = TRUE) || grepl(bn, sn, fixed = TRUE))) return(TRUE)
    if (nchar(bn) >= 35 && nchar(sn) >= 35 && substr(sn, 1, 35) == substr(bn, 1, 35)) return(TRUE)
    FALSE
  }, logical(1)))
}

# Build a small row of icon links (DOI, OSF, GitHub, Google Scholar) for an entry,
# using academicons (ai-*) for scholarly icons and bootstrap-icons (bi-*, already
# bundled with Quarto) for GitHub/generic links.
icon_link <- function(href, icon_class, label) {
  sprintf(
    '<a class="ref-icon" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="%s" title="%s"><i class="%s"></i></a>',
    href, label, label, icon_class
  )
}

make_links <- function(entry) {
  icons <- c()

  doi <- field(entry, "doi")
  doi_clean <- if (nzchar(doi)) sub("^https?://doi\\.org/", "", doi) else ""
  if (nzchar(doi_clean)) {
    doi_url <- paste0("https://doi.org/", doi_clean)
    icons <- c(icons, icon_link(doi_url, "ai ai-doi", "DOI"))
  }

  url <- field(entry, "url")
  # Only add a URL-based icon if it doesn't just resolve the same DOI we already linked
  if (nzchar(url) && (!nzchar(doi_clean) || !grepl(doi_clean, url, fixed = TRUE))) {
    if (grepl("osf\\.io", url, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      icons <- c(icons, icon_link(url, "ai ai-osf", "OSF"))
    } else if (grepl("github\\.com", url, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      icons <- c(icons, icon_link(url, "bi bi-github", "Code on GitHub"))
    } else {
      icons <- c(icons, icon_link(url, "bi bi-link-45deg", "Link"))
    }
  }

  # Only offer a "find this on Google Scholar" link when the entry is actually
  # listed on Ingmar's Scholar profile (see on_scholar() / data/scholar-titles.txt) --
  # otherwise the search would turn up nothing useful and the icon would mislead.
  title <- gsub("[{}]", "", field(entry, "title"))
  if (nzchar(title) && on_scholar(title)) {
    scholar_url <- paste0("https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=", utils::URLencode(title, reserved = TRUE))
    icons <- c(icons, icon_link(scholar_url, "ai ai-google-scholar", "View on Google Scholar"))
  }

  if (length(icons) == 0) return("")
  paste0('<span class="ref-links">', paste(icons, collapse = ""), "</span>")
}

# Format a single author in APA style: "Family, F. M.", bolding Visser
format_person_apa <- function(p) {
  family <- paste(p$family, collapse = " ")
  given  <- p$given
  initials <- if (!is.null(given) && length(given) > 0 && any(nzchar(given))) {
    paste(sapply(given[nzchar(given)], function(g) paste0(substr(trimws(g), 1, 1), ".")), collapse = " ")
  } else ""
  name <- if (nzchar(initials)) paste0(family, ", ", initials) else family
  if (grepl("Visser", family, ignore.case = TRUE)) paste0("**", name, "**") else name
}

# Format authors APA-style, always listing every named author (no et-al truncation
# of our own; "et al." only appears when the bib entry itself has "and others")
format_authors <- function(entry) {
  e <- unclass(entry)[[1]]
  persons <- e[["author"]]
  if (is.null(persons) || length(persons) == 0) return("")

  n <- length(persons)
  last_is_others <- tolower(paste(persons[[n]]$family, collapse = " ")) == "others"
  names_fmt <- vapply(persons, format_person_apa, character(1))

  if (last_is_others) {
    if (n == 1) return("et al.")
    paste0(paste(names_fmt[-n], collapse = ", "), ", et al.")
  } else if (n == 1) {
    names_fmt
  } else if (n == 2) {
    paste(names_fmt[1], "&", names_fmt[2])
  } else {
    paste0(paste(names_fmt[-n], collapse = ", "), ", & ", names_fmt[n])
  }
}

# Format a single entry as a markdown list item
format_entry <- function(entry, show_note = FALSE) {
  authors <- format_authors(entry)
  year    <- field(entry, "year")
  title   <- gsub("[{}]", "", field(entry, "title"))
  journal <- field(entry, "journal")
  volume  <- field(entry, "volume")
  number  <- field(entry, "number")
  pages   <- field(entry, "pages")
  booktitle <- field(entry, "booktitle")
  note    <- field(entry, "note")
  links   <- make_links(entry)

  # Build venue string
  venue <- ""
  if (nzchar(journal)) {
    venue <- paste0("*", journal, "*")
    if (nzchar(volume)) venue <- paste0(venue, ", ", volume)
    if (nzchar(number)) venue <- paste0(venue, "(", number, ")")
    if (nzchar(pages))  venue <- paste0(venue, ", ", pages)
  } else if (nzchar(booktitle)) {
    venue <- paste0("*", booktitle, "*")
  }

  # Status note for in-progress
  status <- ""
  if (show_note && nzchar(note)) {
    status <- paste0(" *[", note, "]*")
  }

  line <- paste0("- ", authors)
  if (nzchar(year)) line <- paste0(line, " (", year, ")")
  line <- paste0(line, '. <span class="paper-title">', title, "</span>")
  if (nzchar(venue)) line <- paste0(line, ". ", venue)
  if (nzchar(links)) line <- paste0(line, " ", links)
  line <- paste0(line, ".", status)

  line
}

# Read bib file
bib_main <- suppressMessages(ReadBib("ingmar.bib", check = "warn"))

entry_type <- function(b, i) tolower(attr(unclass(b[i])[[1]], "bibtype"))

# Separate in-progress (Misc type) from published
is_misc <- function(b) {
  sapply(seq_along(b), function(i) entry_type(b, i) == "misc")
}

all_misc <- bib_main[is_misc(bib_main)]
pub_main <- bib_main[!is_misc(bib_main)]

# Get year from entry
get_year <- function(entry) {
  y <- field(entry, "year")
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(y))
}
```

### Work in progress

::: {.refs-compact}

```{r results='asis'}
years_misc <- sapply(seq_along(all_misc), function(i) get_year(all_misc[i]))
ord <- order(is.na(years_misc), -ifelse(is.na(years_misc), 0L, years_misc))

for (i in ord) {
  cat(format_entry(all_misc[i], show_note = TRUE), "\n")
}
```

:::

### Journal articles

::: {.refs-compact}

```{r results='asis'}
pub_articles <- pub_main[sapply(seq_along(pub_main), function(i) entry_type(pub_main, i) == "article")]
years_art <- sapply(seq_along(pub_articles), function(i) get_year(pub_articles[i]))
unique_years <- sort(unique(years_art[!is.na(years_art)]), decreasing = TRUE)

for (yr in unique_years) {
  cat(sprintf("\n#### %d\n\n", yr))
  idx <- which(years_art == yr)
  titles_yr <- sapply(idx, function(i) field(pub_articles[i], "title"))
  idx <- idx[order(titles_yr)]
  for (i in idx) {
    cat(format_entry(pub_articles[i]), "\n")
  }
}
```

:::

### Book chapters

::: {.refs-compact}

```{r results='asis'}
chapters <- pub_main[sapply(seq_along(pub_main), function(i) entry_type(pub_main, i) %in% c("incollection", "inbook"))]
if (length(chapters) > 0) {
  years_ch <- sapply(seq_along(chapters), function(i) get_year(chapters[i]))
  ord <- order(is.na(years_ch), -ifelse(is.na(years_ch), 0L, years_ch))
  for (i in ord) {
    cat(format_entry(chapters[i]), "\n")
  }
}
```
